newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN AMRO Chicago starts gold stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN AMRO Chicago starts gold stocks.

text.p: --ABN AMRO Chicago Corp analyst Vahid Fathi said he started coverage of eight gold mining stocks with varying investment ratings:
--Amax Gold Inc as a buy. Shares were unchanged at 5-7/8.
--Newmont Mining Corp as a buy. Shares were off 1/2 at 33-1/2.
--Crown Resources Corp as a buy. Shares were unchanged at 6.
--Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp as a hold. Shares were off 1/4 at 14-1/4.
--Barrick Gold Corp as a hold. Shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange were off 0.40 at 30.40.
--Agnico-Eagle Mines Ltd as a hold. Shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange were off 0.10 at 13.80.
--Battle Mountain Gold Co as a hold. Shares were unchanged at 5-3/4.
--Echo Bay Mines Ltd as a sell. Shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange were up 0.15 to 7.80.
